use_env_singleton: access the singleton Env instance via bm.env to get study paths, cache, and feature models
use_temporary_context: use the Env temporary context manager to temporarily override study paths or cache for a code block
use_temporary_from_args: use the Env temporary_from_args context manager to update cache and study paths from an args dictionary
load_study_default_paths: call the Env study_default_paths class method to load study paths from the study_paths.yaml config file
get_host_study_paths: call the Env _get_host_study_paths static method to resolve study paths for the current hostname
